reason: The slip and card import sound like exactly what I wanted, since I quit the budget app because typing everything was a chore. But the offer only names K PLUS, Bangkok Bank and TTB for slips, and it says nothing about which cards the statement import reads, so I can't tell if my bank is covered until I've set up the Shortcut and tried it.
objection: I don't know if it works with my bank or my card, and I'd have to do the Shortcut setup before I find out.
would_change_my_mind: A clear list of the banks and card issuers the statement import supports, so I can check mine before setting anything up.
